## POST `/api/instances/user/name:{name}/action/modify`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Change the local user's password or/and role . Use the roleMapping resource type to change the access privileges for LDAP users and LDAP groups, as described in the associated help topic.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Name of the user . |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `role` | string | Role with which to associate the user . |
| `password` | string | User's new password. The value must match all of following regex expressions `^(?=.*\d)(?!.*[&'])(?!.*[\s])(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z]).{8,64}$` |
| `oldPassword` | string | User's existing password. |

**Responses:** `204` No Content

## POST `/api/types/user/instances`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Create a local user . When you create a local user , the system automatically creates a roleMapping resource for that user , based on the value of the role attribute. Use the roleMapping resource type to create authentication for LDAP users and LDAP groups, as described in the associated help topic.

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | User name. |
| `role` | string | User role . |
| `password` | string | Initial password for the user . The value must match all of following regex expressions `^(?=.*\d)(?!.*[&'])(?!.*[\s])(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z]).{8,64}$` |

**Responses:** `201` Created body fields: `@base`, `updated`, `links`, `content`
